protocol.label: Experimental — limited training data.
protocol.mappingScope: Recorded 24-period evidence; original unverified manifests remain unchanged
protocol.selectionRule: Lowest pooled MAE on identical earlier validation pairs; lexical tie break; no per-horizon tuning
protocol.comparisonRule: Selection requires eligible pairs in every validation fold; B3 tested separately where history exists
protocol.finalFitRule: Refit fixed candidates on all eligible examples before testStart after freezing selection
protocol.truthPolicy: PROVISIONAL, latest revision published and available by each split end
protocol.purging: Every training/validation target interval ends by its split boundary
protocol.testPurpose: NEW_HELD_OUT_CALENDAR_DAY; reconstructed historical forecasts, not prospective serving
protocol.demandWeather: Excluded; price and calendar features only

limitations: One held-out complete day; overlapping forecasts are not independent observations.
Training dates can contain gaps; missing features are imputed from training only, missing target windows excluded.
Later incomplete dates are excluded; October 4, if incomplete, cannot support a full-day claim.
Provisional prices, not final settlement truth. No weather or demand predictors.
Refitted today using historical availability; not proof the artifact was served on the test day.
Earlier test dates may now be development data; their original reports remain unchanged.
No production promotion. Existing history and approval requirements still apply.
